text: Refunds: unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method.
Archived 2019 refund policy: returns were accepted within 60 days of delivery. This policy was replaced in 2021.
Items that arrive damaged or broken are refunded or replaced at no cost if you report it within 7 days of delivery with a photo.
Once a refund is approved, the money reaches your card in 5 to 10 business days.
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. It is free on orders over $50, otherwise it costs $4.99.
Express shipping delivers the next business day for $14.99 if you order before 2pm.
We ship to the EU and the UK. International orders take 7 to 14 days, and customs fees are paid by the customer.
Electronics carry a 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not covered.
To make a warranty claim, open a ticket with your order number and a description of the defect. We reply within 2 business days.
To reset your password, use 'Forgot password' on the login page. The reset link expires after 1 hour.
Two-factor authentication can be turned on in Settings > Security, using an authenticator app.
To delete your account, email privacy@acme.test. Deletion is completed within 30 days.
Acme Plus costs $9 per month or $90 per year, and includes free express shipping.
You can cancel Acme Plus at any time. You keep the benefits until the end of the paid period; there are no partial refunds.
Gift cards never expire. They cannot be refunded or exchanged for cash.
We do not offer price matching with other stores.
Our summer sale ends Friday! Use code SUMMER20 for 20% off everything, shipping included.
Meet the team: our Leeds warehouse packs 10,000 orders a day, and the refund desk has two office dogs.
